100101010.t: When the restoration work ended and I was doing the final inspection with Claire...
Alcatraz Beach
...Phew, nothing wrong here either.
Yeah. My side too.
Alright. Next up is—
Aaargh! I can't take this anymore!!
That's right! Don't you think this is way too much?!
Sigh, there isn't a single quiet day on this damn island...
Pretend we didn't hear?
That's a very tempting offer, but... since today's the last day, I'll provide a little service.
I-I'm telling you, this is really the last thing you have to do!
That's like the millionth time we've heard that line! Do you take us for fools?!
Are you really only satisfied if you keep working us to the bone like this?!

Then play a bit more gently! You keep breaking the things we barely managed to repair
one by one while playing around!!
You there.
No fighting.
What is it now, what happened?
M-Master!!
You came at the right time, Master! Sob sob, please hear us out!
The Head Maid is bullying us by making us work again! Sob sob, please scold her!
I-I'm not bullying you, it's because you girls were playing way too roughly!
I understand you want to enjoy yourselves since it's the last day, but can't you play without breaking things?!
Ugh... St-Still, we're not working anymore! No matter what!
Th-That's right! Even if we have to fight, we'll protect the rest of our vacation!!
Alright, stop.
I get the general situation. Now, this is glaringly obvious, but...
...It's painfully obvious that this is your fault, Head Maid.
...Huh?
What...?
Whaaaat?!!??!
M-M-M-Master?!? Wh-Wh-What on earth do you mean by—
I mean, it might be a bit random to bring up now, but...
Why have you been bundling yourself up so tight all this time?
......P-Pardon?
With all the restoration work and everything, I haven't had a chance to really get a good look, but...
It looks great on you. Why haven't you been dressing like this all along?
......Uh, what? I-I mean......
Sh-Should I say... th-thank you...?
But this is a swimsuit, so I only wore it for the vacation... I have to wear my maid outfit normally.
What? You mean you're not going to wear it once vacation is over?!
No way, keep dressing like this even after it's over!
Th-That's impossible!! How could I do that when I'm the Head Maid...!!

No matter how much you ask, Master, a no is a no!
I-I mean, I'm glad you like it, of course!
......Is that so? Guess I have no choice then.
...Phew, thank you. For understandi—
It's been quite a while since we broke out of the Panoticon, right?
Face me, Head Maid.
We settle this in battle—for your <bouten>24/7 swimsuit requirement</bouten>.
Whaaaaaat?!!???!
Wh-What on earth is...?
...Should we just stay quiet...?

100101020.t: Kh...! Haah, haah...
How about it? Do you feel like wearing a swimsuit 24/7, 365 days a year now?
Even if it's your command, Master... I absolutely cannot do that...
I am the Head Maid... It's only natural for me to wear a maid uniform.
That's why I will never back down...!!
...Mmm. Fixer.
Looks like the Head Maid's meat is her maid uniform.
Huh?
So could you let it go this time?
Taking away someone's meat is a bad thing to do.
Claire...
...Sigh, fine. Alright, alright.
I don't want to force it when she goes that far anyway.
Yeah. Thanks.
By the way, that's surprising. I didn't expect you to say something like that.
Looks like you've gotten pretty close to the Head Maid.
Yeah. She gave me advice once before.
Back then, the Head Maid—
Cl-Claire! Th-Thank you for helping me!
And... Master, thank you for understanding as well.
Whatever. Half of it was a joke anyway.
Th-This might not be much of a substitute, but...
Later... when it's just the two of us...
Th-Then, I'll dress however you want, Master...
B-But only when we're alone...!
Deal. We'll discuss that privately later then.
Remember, I didn't say a thing! You came up with that yourself!
Ngh... Y-Yes...
Okay, so now that our chat is pretty much wrapped up...
Alright, time to start the restoration work.
...Why are you looking at us when you say that...
We should all work together and play together, right?
Sob... I knew it was going to end up like this...
S-Since it came to this, maybe we should just finish it quickly...
It was summer.
